messages:
jun: kicking off a mini-burnin for candidate-model-v1.1-q8 on the canary pool (5% traffic). plan: 6h shadow + 1h active mini-burnin, then metrics compare.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary group 'mini-burnin-1712349999' -> 5% traffic, image=candidate-model-v1.1-q8

samir: quick ask — which gating signals are we using for auto-fallback?

olga: logging: latency (p50/p95), semantic-F1 on eval set, hallucination rate on FAQ set, token cost. baseline = prod-stable-v2.

maria: propose hard thresholds: auto-fallback if semantic-F1 relative drop >= 1.5% OR hallucination-rate increase >= 0.5pp, unless p95 latency improvement > 30% AND cost/tok reduction > 15%.

kevin: can we express the cost/latency tradeoff as a single score? like weighted delta = -0.6*latency_delta_pct + 0.4*quality_delta_pct, and require weighted delta >= 0 for promotion?

jun: I don't want an opaque combined score for the first run. let's keep simple rules for now — cost wins only if quality regressions are within 1% absolute. otherwise fallback.

samir: agree on conservative default. also want an A/B check on live traffic for at least 30m after shadow to surface subtle QA regressions.

olga: initial smoke results (internal): p95 latency prod=92ms -> canary=64ms (≈30% improvement), cost/token -18%, semantic-F1 prod=0.934 -> canary=0.926 (relative -0.86%). hallucination-count on FAQ set: prod=3/100 -> canary=5/100.

maria: 0.86% F1 drop is under 1% but hallucination +2 is concerning. we should flag the specific failing cases before letting it progress.

smoke-bot: smoke-run-1712350200: 12/13 tests passed. failed test: "faq-hallucination-case-7". logs -> https://redwood.internal/bugs/RED-4521

kevin: link to RED-4521 added. can someone check if that case is a deterministic regression from quantization or upstream tokenization change?

jun: olga to run deterministic seed replay and log kv-cache diffs. please run replay with `./eval_harness run --model candidate-model-v1.1-q8 --cases faq-hallucination-case-7 --seed 42 --dump-kv`

olga: running replay now. I'll also keep full response diffs in shadow-log for 48h.

samir: suggested rollout schedule if we pass: 5% -> 20% (30m hold) -> 50% (1h hold) -> 100%, with metric checks at each step: semantic-F1 delta <= 1%, hallucination delta <= +0.5pp, p95 not worse than prod.

jun: agree with schedule but will add: abort immediately if semantic-F1 delta > 1.0% at any hold point.

deploy-bot: canary metrics (after 45m): p50 28ms -> 20ms, p95 92ms -> 64ms, cost/tok 0.82 -> 0.67, semantic-F1 0.934 -> 0.926, hallucination 3/100 -> 5/100.

maria: :thinking_face: borderline. 0.8% F1 drop is within the 1% allowance, but hallucination increase is the actionable risk. need root cause before promoting to 20%.

jun: agreed. if replay shows quantization-specific corruption on that FAQ, we rollback. if it's tokenization mismatch, we can patch tokenizer mapping and re-run.

olga: replay done — deterministic diff shows small logit shift at token boundary for case-7, likely due to per-channel quant scaling. opening quick PR to adjust per-channel clamp and rerun. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/2012

smoke-bot: rerun smoke after PR applied: 13/13 tests passed. smoke-run-1712352800.

kevin: nice. can we also surface per-case confidence deltas in console so product can spot regression patterns?

jun: yes, dashboard change request filed. but for rollout now — proceed to 20% with 30m hold and strict checks. olga, maria monitor the 30m window. I'll abort if any metric crosses thresholds.

olga: will monitor and keep shadow logs for 48h. I'll post the gate config in the repo (canary-configs/mini-burnin-1712349999.yaml).

maria: documenting gating rules in the ticket and notifying support for potential rollback noise. :thumbsup:

jun: thanks all — closing this thread once 20% hold completes successfully.
